description: Read Product Catalogs and Product Items when catalog access is available. Returns join-ready product metadata without creating or updating catalog assets.

businessId.description: Business Manager ID used to discover owned/client product catalogs.

catalogId.description: Product Catalog ID to read directly.

includeProductSets.description: Also attempt product_sets edges for catalog context.

includeProducts.description: Fetch product items for discovered/provided catalogs.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

productIds.description: Specific Product Item IDs to fetch via the batch IDs endpoint.

search.description: Client-side substring filter across product id, retailer_id, name, brand, category, type, and custom labels.

name: meta_get_catalog_products

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: meta get catalog products
